content:
Maya (CS): FYI KeplerAI onboarding this week. They need EU routing + temp qps bump while they run a data migration. Asked for 300 qps for 48-72h and an IP allowlist for their peering range. They want auto-revoke after the window.
Tony (Infra): @Maya what's their org id + CIDR? we need to check allocs. 300 qps short-term probably OK if routed to eu-west1; depends on shard utilization. Send sample headers/config.
Maya (CS): Org: keplerai-prod, CIDR: 34.120.0.0/22 (customer provided). Target region: eu-west1. Desired start: 2026-03-25 09:00 UTC. Duration requested: 72h (they said 48 if load looks low). Auto-revoke: yes.
Tony (Infra): OK checking. Also: confirm whether they’re on hosted API or any Dedicated commitment? If hosted, we can apply a soft qps bump at edge via per-org throttle and a temporary route rule. If Dedicated, we’d need to adjust pool config.
Liz (Acct Exec): They’re currently on self-serve hosted with rising MRR. Renewal in ~2 months. If onboarding friction happens this bump -> renewal risk. Suggest we offer a short-term dedicated trial if they show sustained traffic after onboarding.
Sam (EngOncall): @Tony I can pre-config alerting. Also flag: prefix/KV cache warming during migration may spike token usage; recommend shorter batch sizes during the run. I can whitelist their IP on the edge for the duration.
Tony (Infra): Quick ops config snippet for the staging run:\n\n```json\n{\n  "org": "keplerai-prod",\n  "region": "eu-west1",\n  "qps": 300,\n  "duration_hours": 72,\n  "auto_revoke": true,\n  "ip_allowlist": ["34.120.0.0/22"]\n}\n```\n\nMaya (CS): Added note: customer will run heavy evals midday Thu -> expect burst. I'll schedule an enablement walkthrough Wed 16:00 UTC to go over best practices. @Liz can you join for a short renewal check-in?
Liz (Acct Exec): Yes, please add me. I’ll prep a quick cost comparison (hosted vs short Dedicated trial) so we can frame next steps if they keep traffic.
Tony (Infra): Thumbs up. I’ll stage the route rule and deploy the allowlist to edge 1h before the start time. /assign @Sam to verify logs + revoke job.
keplerops-bot: PROVISIONING_REQUEST received for org keplerai-prod. Request ID: kr-20260321-001. ETA: 2h to stage and smoke-test.
Sam (EngOncall): Confirmed I’ll monitor token-per-minute and set an alert at 90% of provisioned qps. If we see sustained >350 qps I’ll flip the circuit breaker and fallback to a compatible smaller model to protect latency SLOs.
Maya (CS): Also asked: do they need service-account keys for peering? Answer: no, just CIDR + TLS mutual auth for the peering link. I’ve sent the onboarding checklist to the customer.
Tony (Infra): One operational detail: auto_revoke will enqueue a ticket for the audit team when the window ends. Please add the expected revoke timestamp to the ticket: 2026-03-28T09:00:00Z.
Maya (CS): Will add that. Anything else from Sales/Acct? @Liz any messaging tweaks for renewal?
Liz (Acct Exec): Keep the initial messaging focused on performance and predictability. If the trial shows steady usage, we recommend a Dedicated conversion and present a cost/sla uplift. I’ll follow up after the enablement session.
Maya (CS): Closing loop — I’ll post final start time tomorrow after staging completes. :thumbsup:
